parsed.rationale: Both participating records are unnamed extensions on RangeReplaceableCollection within package 'app:iOS', but every structural evidence field is null (jaccard, shared_field_count, differing_slots, shared_ancestor are all null) and both records carry empty fields_or_signature lists. Without any member-level evidence there is no basis for concluding the two extensions overlap in behaviour rather than merely sharing the extended type by coincidence. One extension lives in 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/NowPlayingWidgetTests.swift' (a Tests path) and the other in 'WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift', suggesting divergent purposes — test-support helpers vs. production widget utilities — that happen to extend the same standard-library type. Recommending consolidation without member evidence would risk coupling unrelated concerns.
